nodes.label: .`a phone with formatting is reduced to digits and moves to the code step with its length`()
.`AC-107 a phone without digits or not a Telegram number is invalid and the attempt stays at the phone step`()
.`AC-107 a banned number is refused and the attempt stays at the phone step`()
.`AC-107 an unregistered number is refused, the attempt stays at the phone step on a fresh session`()
.`AC-107 an unregistered number found at the code step is refused and ends the attempt`()
.`AC-107 an unregistered number with no replacement session is refused as unregistered, attempt ended`()
.`AC-107 a phone refused on resend ends the attempt, as at the code step`()
.`AC-02 a wrong or expired code is refused and the attempt stays at the code step, a new code can be asked`()
.`AC-02 a wait on the phone step ends the attempt and destroys its session, with the retry time`()
.`AC-02 a wait on the code step ends the attempt`()
.`a right code moves to the password step with the hint, or hands over the authorized account`()
.`AC-106 a wrong password carries the hint, none when unset, and the attempt stays at the password step`()
.`a right password hands over the authorized account`()
.`AC-02 a wait on the password step ends the attempt`()
.`a step for another step is a mismatch carrying the current step and changes nothing`()
.`a step after the Sign-in Session ended discards the attempt`()
.`Telegram not answering is unavailable and the attempt stays at its step`()
.`step durations are recorded and well under the three second target on the fake`()
.`a wait counts as a flood_wait outcome`()
